name: mobster
description: Check iOS screens on a headless simulator and drive a real iPhone over USB.
long_description: Mobster's MCP server for Claude Desktop. It needs the mobster command on this Mac: install it with `curl -fsSL https://mobster.dev/install.sh | sh` or `brew install radishsoftware/tap/mobster`. The bundle holds only a small script that finds that command and runs `mobster mcp`.
